Are you ready to revolutionize the way you code? Discover how AI is transforming software development. Learn the basics of AI-assisted coding and how it can accelerate your workflow from concept to deployment.

Get hands-on with modern frameworks and AI tools to create powerful, interactive web applications with ease—even as a beginner.

Bring your projects to life by deploying them to Vercel. Learn step-by-step how to take your app from local code to a live, shareable website in minutes.

Experience your app the way your users will. Learn how to preview and test your projects on mobile devices before launch, ensuring smooth performance across platforms.

6. Connecting to Databases
Unlock the power of persistent data. Learn how to integrate databases into your apps with AI-assisted guidance, from setup to queries and optimization.

7. Debugging and Optimization with AI
Say goodbye to endless bug hunts. Discover how AI can help identify, debug, and optimize your code, making your apps faster and more reliable.
